Potential reconstructed from the already verified complete linear master equations and W K symmetry. Absolute normalization comes from the ADM action.
Canonical branch covariance contains P_r/(C mu_r); the light projector alone does not suppress intrinsic vacuum noise.
Positive gamma-ratio and heat-sum estimates bound all l>=2, both branches and all central radial modes without numerical tail extrapolation.
